title: Cabo Verde calculator readiness research — Batch 40

findings.detail: FAO's January 2026 country brief estimates 2025 maize output at about 1,100 tonnes, nearly 40% below the already low previous five-year average. The estimate is preliminary and lacks a matching harvested-area denominator, so no yield is calculated.

Government announced CVE 44.5 million to strengthen the rainfed campaign through subsidized seeds, planting materials and technical assistance. This is a national programme budget, not a farmer unit cost or per-hectare budget.
Resolution 88/2025 mandates the VI General Agricultural Census during 2025–2026 across family and non-family agricultural holdings. Final numeric tables remain pending.
The existing 22-municipality lookup remains in place; no municipality-level crop yield series has been verified.

The Ministry market observatory is identified but the accessible page does not expose current dated farm-gate price values. Farmer-paid input, labour, irrigation, machinery and transport costs remain unavailable.

sources.title: FAO GIEWS Cabo Verde Country Brief, 19 January 2026

safeguards: CVE 44.5 million programme investment not used as a farm cost.
Preliminary maize production not converted into yield without harvested area.
Retail observations and price movements not treated as farm-gate prices.
